correctness.evidence: Independent prime enumeration and modular arithmetic reproduce the ten-prime window and residue vector. Das–Jha arXiv:2508.05361v2 Lemma 2.4 gives h3(12l)=2 iff (3/l)_3=1 for l=7 mod 9, and Theorem A gives the necessary cube-sum condition, so the six residue failures are valid non-cube-sum certificates.

originality.evidence: The general criterion is prior work; the claimed residual originality is only the explicit consecutive l>2000 window and six certified witnesses. Searches of the checked full text and related literature did not locate this same window.

value.evidence: The six examples are exact root-number-1 test instances for a recognized cube-sum/Selmer obstruction family; the record honestly leaves four cases open and does not claim a new general theorem.
